title: Deposit Limits and Combined Balance Cap for Pocketwire Savings Vaults
content:
Pocketwire Savings Vault deposit limits and the balance cap are applied to all of a customer's vaults together.

## Limits by tier

| | Pocketwire Vault Essential | Pocketwire Vault Select | Pocketwire Vault Preferred | Pocketwire Vault Premier | Pocketwire Vault Reserve | Pocketwire Vault Private |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Daily deposit limit | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | $25000.00 | $50000.00 | $100000.00 | $250000.00 |
| Monthly deposit limit | $20000.00 | $50000.00 | $100000.00 | $250000.00 | $500000.00 | $1000000.00 |
| Maximum combined vault balance | $25000.00 | $50000.00 | $100000.00 | $250000.00 | $500000.00 | $1000000.00 |

## Rule

A deposit is declined in full if it would take:
1. the combined vault balance above the tier's maximum combined vault balance; or
2. the day's deposits above the daily deposit limit; or
3. the month's deposits above the monthly deposit limit.

**Definitions.** The combined vault balance is the total of the balances of the customer's vaults that are not closed. The day's deposits are all deposits into any of the customer's vaults dated the handling calendar day, Eastern Time. The month's deposits are all deposits into any of the customer's vaults dated in the calendar month containing the handling date. In each test the deposit being assessed is counted together with what is already recorded.

## Judgement table

| Would the deposit take the total above... | Result |
|---|---|
| the maximum combined vault balance | Declined in full |
| the daily deposit limit | Declined in full |
| the monthly deposit limit | Declined in full |
| none of the three | Not declined by these limits |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical customers, Pocketwire Vault Essential figures)

- Deposits already recorded today across the customer's vaults total $4200.00. A deposit of $800.00 brings the day to exactly $5000.00, which is not above the daily limit. A deposit of $900.00 would bring the day to $5100.00 and is declined in full: no part of the $900.00 is accepted.
- The combined vault balance is $24950.00. A deposit of $50.00 brings it to exactly $25000.00, which is not above the maximum; a deposit of $60.00 would take it to $25010.00 and is declined in full.
- Deposits already recorded this calendar month total $19500.00. A deposit of $600.00 would take the month to $20100.00 and is declined in full, even where the day's deposits remain within the daily limit.
